paragraphs.text: The diary of Thomas Reid, who kept the lighthouse on Skerry Rock from 1861 to 1889, was found in an attic in 2019. Reid recorded the weather every morning at 6 am and noted each ship that passed. Historians have used his notes to show that storms in the area were more frequent in the 1870s than at any time since.
paragraphs.label: A
